personality_one_liner: A warm, curated editorial community experience blending high-contrast Lora serif typography with soft terracotta accents and breathing room.

spacing.rule: Editorial rhythm. Generous vertical breathing room. Typographic hierarchy dictates separation instead of hard dividers. Minimum touch targets 44pt.

do's: Use solid surface colors or soft brand tints
Prioritize typographic layout and whitespace over layer depth
dont's: Do not use blur or glass effects anywhere in this app. Keep it paper-like, flat, and tactile.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: A warm welcome setting up the user profile, interests, and suggested circles.

states.error: Soft terracotta toast anchored top, no hard shadows.

screens.layout: Full-bleed atmospheric terracotta gradient scene per step. Content overlaid via top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse). Primary actions stick to bottom thumb zone.

screens.name: Home Timeline Feed
screens.purpose: Curated editorial feed displaying personal timeline posts, photos, likes, and comments.

states.loading: Skeleton feed cards with muted pulsing
states.empty: Editorial illustration + 'Your feed is quiet. Discover new circles to begin.' + Join Circles CTA.
states.error: Text-heavy error + 'Retry' text link with terracotta underline.

screens.layout: Mini-magazine layout. Left-aligned Lora headings. Meta-data in small caps DM Sans. Generous padding between feed cards (24-32pt). Images have subtle rounded corners (radius md). No heavy card shadows—delineate posts by whitespace and a 1px soft border or divider.

screens.name: Circles Directory & Explore
screens.purpose: Discover and browse communities using filtered chip rows.

states.empty: Empty state illustration + 'No circles match your search.'

screens.layout: Sticky horizontal filter chip row at top (terracotta outlined when active). List of cards acting as curated directory items: Large cover image, Lora headline, concise sans-serif metadata (member count, category). Primary 'Join' button directly accessible on the card.

screens.name: Circle Detail
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific community's Posts, Events, and About info.

states.loading: Spinner centered in the tab area
states.empty: Content tab is empty. 'Be the first to post in this circle.'

screens.layout: Hero image banner with top-to-bottom gradient scrim. Large Lora heading for the community name floating over the scrim bottom. Below header: A clear 'Join' CTA, member count row, and an editorial sticky tab bar (Posts, Events, About). Vertically scrolling content sectioned by bold typography.

screens.name: Messaging Inbox
screens.purpose: Direct messages and circle group chats in one calm list.

states.empty: Quiet illustration + 'No active conversations. Reach out in a circle.'

screens.layout: Clean, flat list format. Avatar circle on left, strong name in Lora, 1-line snippet in DM Sans. Unread indicators as small brandPrimary dots. Inside chat: Flat conversation bubbles (surfaceSecondary for received, brandTertiary for sent) without tails. Sticky composer at bottom above keyboard.

screens.name: Live Rooms
screens.purpose: Scheduled live listening and speaking rooms with real-time text chat.

states.empty: Schedule calendar empty state + 'No rooms live right now.'

screens.layout: Split layout: Top 40% holds host avatars and Lora title against a warm off-white or dark background (not a loud gradient). Bottom 60% holds the real-time chat feed. Flat bottom action bar for microphone toggle, raise hand, and text input.

screens.name: Coins Wallet & Gifting
screens.purpose: View coin balance, recent transactions, and purchase more.
screens.layout: Simple receipt-book aesthetic. Large serif number for balance at top. Transaction history presented as a clean, minimal list beneath a divider. No neon gamification.

home_feed_hero.alt: Diverse friends walking outdoors under cloudy sky

circle_cover_creative.alt: Team brainstorming in a modern office

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Lora (serif) for display/headings and DM Sans (sans-serif) for body text and UI components. Ensure weight never exceeds 500 (use 400 for regular, 500 for emphasis).
Enforce the 'Warm Editorial' personality strictly: Use the provided light/dark mode color tokens. Terracotta (brandPrimary) is the only accent—no blues, indigos, or purples anywhere in the app.
Never use glassmorphism or blur effects. This app uses solid paper-like background surfaces (`surface`, `surfaceSecondary`) to build elevation and separation.

For all background images containing overlaid text (e.g., Onboarding backgrounds, Circle Detail covers), implement the mandatory 3-stop vertical gradient scrim (`transparent` to `surfaceInverse` at ≥70% opacity).
Ensure safe area usage is applied correctly. For Live Rooms, ensure the real-time chat input is protected by KeyboardAvoidingView.
Include empty states on all data-driven screens (Feeds, Chat list, Wallet, Circles directory).
Use flat, 1px or 0.5px `border` properties instead of box shadows to separate cards if whitespace is not enough.
